title: The Reed Boat
text: A boat of woven reeds is tied at the water's edge, a paddle laid in it. A note weighted with a stone reads: take me where you need to go. The handwriting is neat and careful, the ink still wet.

options.label: Take the boat and trust whoever left it.

outcomes.text: It carries you far and lets you off gently, then drifts back the way it came.
It carries you somewhere it wanted to go.

options.label: The wisest reads the note again, to learn whose hand wrote it.

outcomes.text: It was written in a drowned woman's hand. You leave the boat where it is.

options.label: Burn the boat; no gift out here comes without a hook.

outcomes.text: Something in the water screams. It does not follow.
